"''Thank you.|Omera and Din Djarin|}} '''Omera''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] from the [[planet]] of [[Sorgan]]. At some point, she became a [[widow]]. In [[9 ABY]], a [[Klatooinian raiders|band]] of [[Klatooinian]] [[Pirate|raiders]] attacked her [[Unidentified village (Sorgan)|village]] and [[Unidentified human tribe|people]]. However, after the raiders stole [[Krill]] the villagers had [[Farm|gathered]], [[Mandalorian]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Din Djarin]] was contacted by [[Caben]] and [[Stoke]], who attempted to recruit the Mandalorian for the defense of their home. Although Djarin was first hesitant, he ultimately accepted. Djarin teamed up with ex-[[Shock trooper]] [[Carasynthia Dune]] and trained the villagers in [[Unarmed combat|hand-to-hand combat]] as well as in [[Blaster|shooting]]. After Djarin and Dune destroyed the Klatooinian raiders' camp, the raiders attacked the village with their [[All Terrain Scout Transport|AT-ST]], however, they were ultimately defeated by the villagers and the [[Mercenary|mercenaries]]. After the successful defense of her village, Djarin and Dune settled in the village. At that point, Omera met with Djarin, who informed her that [[Din Grogu|Grogu]], a child that was accompanying him, would be staying in the village with the other kids, such as Omera's [[daughter]], [[Winta]]. However, a [[Unidentified Kubaz bounty hunter|Kubaz bounty hunter]] attempted to kill Grogu after he tracked the Child with a [[Tracking fob]]. Forcing Dune to defeat him and Djarin to abandon the village, as bounty hunters would continue to attack Grogu and the village. Omera and her daughter then bid farewell to Djarin and Grogu, who left with their belongings, causing Winta to cry. ==Biography== {{Quote|This nice man is going to help protect us from the bad ones.|Omera to Winta, on Din Djarin|}} [[File:Omera_Barn_The_Mandalorian.png|thumb|left|250px|Omera provided lodging for the Mandalorian.]] At some point, Omera had a daughter, [[Winta]], but was later widowed. She resided with her [[Unidentified human tribe|tribe]] at a [[Unidentified village (Sorgan)|village]] on the [[planet]] [[Sorgan]], taking care of her daughter and [[Farmer|farming]] [[Krill (creature)|krill]]. The village became the site of frequent attacks by [[Klatooinian raiders]], forcing Omera and the villagers to remain hidden to avoid being caught by them. Fellow villagers [[Caben]] and [[Stoke]] convinced the [[bounty hunter]] known as Din Djarin to help defend their village, who also brought former [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebel]] [[shock trooper]] [[Carasynthia Dune]] alongside him. When they arrived in the village, Omera provided lodging to Din Djarin. When Djarin was alerted to Winta's presence, Omera comforted the girl, explaining that he was here to protect the village. She later arrived with a tray of [[Foodstuff|food]] and asked why he never removed his [[helmet]] publicly, learning of his past and the [[Way of the Mandalore|way of life]] he followed. [[File:Omera_Defense_The_Mandalorian.png|thumb|right|250px|Omera helped repel the attack.]] When Dune and Din Djarin investigated the [[Klatooinian]] raiders and discovered the tracks of an [[AT-ST Raider|AT-ST]], they announced to the villagers that they would have to migrate elsewhere. Omera stated that the farmers had nowhere else to go. After the two agreed to train the tribe, Omera and a number of villagers were trained in using [[blaster]]s by Din Djarin. Omera displayed her prowess in using a [[Relby-v10 micro grenade launcher]], catching the attention of the bounty hunter. Following their training, Djarin told Omera to prepare for the attack as him and Dune departed to provoke the Klatooinian raiders. When the two returned, Omera and the tribe repelled the attack. [[File:OmeraMando-TMCh4.png|thumb|left|250px|Omera asked Djarin to stay on Sorgan.]] A few weeks after the battle, Dune and Din Djarin settled in the village. Omera provided a cup of [[spotchka]] to Dune while commenting to Djarin that [[Din Grogu|Grogu]] was happy to be living at the village. He later informed her that he would be leaving Grogu behind in order to keep him safe. Omera asked Din Djarin to stay and attempted to remove his helmet but, was stopped by him, stating that only Grogu belonged here. Their conversation was interrupted by a gunshot, which turned out to be Dune killing a [[Unidentified Kubaz bounty hunter|bounty hunter]] that attempted to eliminate Grogu. Knowing that his life was still in danger, Djarin decided to leave the planet with him. Omera thanked him as he parted ways with Dune and the tribe. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|It's very nice here.''"
"''Yes.''"
"''I think it's clear he's… He's happy here.''"
"''What about you? Are you happy here? We want you to stay.|Din Djarin and Omera|}} [[File:Omera.png|thumb|right200px|Omera was confident and natural leader.]] Omera was a human female hailing from Sorgan, she had tan skin, brown hair and brown eyes. She stood at 1.73 [[meter]]s. ==Skills and abilities== {{Quote|The sun is about to set, and we'll be leaving soon. When we return, we'll be coming in hot.''"
"''We'll be ready.|Din Djarin and Omera|}} Omera was the only person out of her entire village that knew how to shoot with a blaster before Din Djarin taught her village's adults how. She was also able to lead her village while defending her people from the Klatooinians. ==Behind the scenes== Omera was portrayed by [[Julia Jones]] in [[Chapter 4: Sanctuary|Chapter 4]] of [[Jon Favreau]]'s [[2019]] [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', which aired on [[November 29]], 2019.{{WebCite|url=https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/documents/the_mandalorian_project_one-sheet_10_ec1e005f.pdf|text=The Mandalorian Media Kit|work=[https://dtcimedia.disney.com Disney Direct-to-Consumer & International]|archivedate=20230315011507}} Stunt work for the character was performed by [[Lauren Mary Kim]], who also acted as the double for [[The Armorer]] in the series.{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 8: Redemption}} ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Omera}} *[[The Mandalorian Junior Novel|''The Mandalorian'' Junior Novel]] {{Ab|The Mandalorian Junior Novel (audiobook)}} *''[[The Mandalorian: Season 1: Volume 1]]'' *[[The Mandalorian – The Graphic Novel of Season 1|''The Mandalorian'' – The Graphic Novel of Season 1]] *{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 4: Sanctuary}} {{1st}} *[[The Mandalorian 4|''The Mandalorian'' 4]] *''[[The Mandalorian: This is the Way]]'' *''[[The Mandalorian: A Clan of Two]]'' ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|aOC8E8z_ifw|The Mandalorian | Official Trailer | Disney+ | Streaming Nov. 12|sw_url=video/the-mandalorian-official-trailer}} {{1stp}} *{{SWYouTube|XmI7WKrAtqs|The Mandalorian – Official Trailer 2 | Disney+ | Streaming Nov. 12|sw_url=video/trailer-2-the-mandalorian}} *{{DisneyGallery|Directing}} *{{DisneyGallery|Legacy}} *{{DisneyGallery|Cast}} *{{DisneyGallery|Process}} *{{SW|url=news/bounty-hunting-highlights-the-mandalorian-chapter-4-sanctuary|text=Bounty Hunting Highlights: 6 of Our Favorite Moments from ''The Mandalorian'' -
